weather and seasons.en: In winter it gets dark so early that by six it's already pitch black.
weather and seasons.pt: No inverno escurece tão cedo que às seis já é noite fechada.

weather and seasons.text: Ojalá deje de llover antes de la boda, porque la ceremonia es al aire libre.
weather and seasons.en: I hope it stops raining before the wedding, because the ceremony is outdoors.
weather and seasons.pt: Tomara que pare de chover antes do casamento, porque a cerimônia é ao ar livre.

weather and seasons.text: Las temperaturas han bajado diez grados de golpe y todo el mundo se ha resfriado.
weather and seasons.en: Temperatures have dropped ten degrees all of a sudden and everyone has caught a cold.
weather and seasons.pt: As temperaturas caíram dez graus de repente e todo mundo ficou resfriado.

weather and seasons.text: En agosto Sevilla es un horno, así que te recomiendo que vayas en otra época.
weather and seasons.en: In August Seville is like an oven, so I recommend you go at another time of year.
weather and seasons.pt: Em agosto Sevilha é um forno, então recomendo que você vá em outra época.

weather and seasons.text: Me encanta pasear por el parque cuando el suelo está cubierto de hojas secas.
weather and seasons.en: I love walking in the park when the ground is covered in dry leaves.
weather and seasons.pt: Adoro passear pelo parque quando o chão está coberto de folhas secas.

weather and seasons.text: Según el pronóstico, el lunes subirán las temperaturas y volverá el buen tiempo.
weather and seasons.en: According to the forecast, temperatures will rise on Monday and the good weather will return.
weather and seasons.pt: Segundo a previsão, na segunda as temperaturas vão subir e o tempo bom vai voltar.

weather and seasons.text: Se me olvidó el paraguas y llegué empapado al trabajo.
weather and seasons.en: I forgot my umbrella and arrived at work soaked.
weather and seasons.pt: Esqueci o guarda-chuva e cheguei encharcado ao trabalho.

weather and seasons.text: ¿No te parece raro que haga tanto calor a finales de octubre?
weather and seasons.en: Don't you think it's strange that it's so hot at the end of October?
weather and seasons.pt: Você não acha estranho fazer tanto calor no fim de outubro?

weather and seasons.text: Cuando era pequeño, nevaba casi todos los inviernos en mi pueblo, pero ahora casi nunca.
weather and seasons.en: When I was little, it snowed almost every winter in my village, but now it hardly ever does.
weather and seasons.pt: Quando eu era pequeno, nevava quase todo inverno na minha cidade, mas agora quase nunca.

weather and seasons.text: El viento era tan fuerte que tuvimos que recoger la sombrilla y volver a casa.
weather and seasons.en: The wind was so strong that we had to take down the beach umbrella and go home.
weather and seasons.pt: O vento estava tão forte que tivemos que fechar o guarda-sol e voltar para casa.

weather and seasons.text: Es mejor que salgas a correr temprano, antes de que apriete el calor.
weather and seasons.en: It's better to go running early, before the heat really kicks in.
weather and seasons.pt: É melhor você sair para correr cedo, antes que o calor aperte.

weather and seasons.text: La lluvia de anoche ha venido de maravilla para el campo, que estaba muy seco.
weather and seasons.en: Last night's rain was great for the fields, which were very dry.
weather and seasons.pt: A chuva de ontem à noite veio em ótima hora para o campo, que estava muito seco.

weather and seasons.text: En primavera el tiempo es tan cambiante que nunca sé qué ponerme por la mañana.
weather and seasons.en: In spring the weather is so changeable that I never know what to wear in the morning.
weather and seasons.pt: Na primavera o tempo é tão instável que nunca sei o que vestir de manhã.

weather and seasons.text: Hacía tanto frío en Burgos que se nos congelaron las manos paseando junto a la catedral.
weather and seasons.en: It was so cold in Burgos that our hands froze while we were walking by the cathedral.
weather and seasons.pt: Estava tão frio em Burgos que nossas mãos congelaram enquanto passeávamos perto da catedral.

weather and seasons.text: Por la ola de calor, recomiendan no salir a la calle entre las doce y las cinco.
weather and seasons.en: Because of the heatwave, they recommend not going outside between twelve and five.
weather and seasons.pt: Por causa da onda de calor, recomendam não sair na rua entre o meio-dia e as cinco.

weather and seasons.text: Me gustaría vivir en un sitio donde los inviernos no fueran tan largos y grises.
weather and seasons.en: I'd like to live somewhere where the winters weren't so long and grey.
weather and seasons.pt: Eu gostaria de morar num lugar onde os invernos não fossem tão longos e cinzentos.

weather and seasons.text: ¡Mira qué arcoíris tan bonito ha salido detrás de las montañas!
weather and seasons.en: Look at the beautiful rainbow that's appeared behind the mountains!
weather and seasons.pt: Olha que arco-íris lindo apareceu atrás das montanhas!

weather and seasons.text: Haga el tiempo que haga, la cabalgata de Reyes saldrá a las seis.
weather and seasons.en: Whatever the weather, the Three Kings parade will set off at six.
weather and seasons.pt: Faça o tempo que fizer, o desfile dos Reis Magos vai sair às seis.

weather and seasons.text: Al final no llovió, así que cargué con el paraguas todo el día para nada.
weather and seasons.en: In the end it didn't rain, so I lugged the umbrella around all day for nothing.
weather and seasons.pt: No fim não choveu, então carreguei o guarda-chuva o dia todo à toa.

weather and seasons.text: Desde que pusimos las placas solares, aprovechamos mucho más los días de sol.
weather and seasons.en: Since we put in solar panels, we make much more of the sunny days.
weather and seasons.pt: Desde que instalamos os painéis solares, aproveitamos muito mais os dias de sol.

weather and seasons.text: El granizo de ayer destrozó la cosecha de mis tíos y abolló varios coches.
weather and seasons.en: Yesterday's hail destroyed my aunt and uncle's harvest and dented several cars.
weather and seasons.pt: O granizo de ontem destruiu a colheita dos meus tios e amassou vários carros.

weather and seasons.text: No me extraña que estés helado si sales en manga corta con este tiempo.
weather and seasons.en: No wonder you're frozen if you go out in short sleeves in this weather.
weather and seasons.pt: Não me admira que você esteja congelado se sai de manga curta com este tempo.

weather and seasons.text: En la costa mediterránea los inviernos son suaves, mientras que en la meseta hiela a menudo.
weather and seasons.en: On the Mediterranean coast the winters are mild, whereas on the central plateau there's often frost.
weather and seasons.pt: No litoral mediterrâneo os invernos são amenos, enquanto no planalto central costuma gear.

weather and seasons.text: ¿Crees que hará suficiente calor en junio para bañarnos en el Cantábrico?
weather and seasons.en: Do you think it'll be warm enough in June to swim in the Bay of Biscay?
weather and seasons.pt: Você acha que vai fazer calor suficiente em junho para nadarmos no mar Cantábrico?

weather and seasons.text: Ayer hubo una tormenta tan fuerte que se fue la luz en todo el barrio.
weather and seasons.en: Yesterday there was such a strong storm that the power went out in the whole neighbourhood.
weather and seasons.pt: Ontem teve uma tempestade tão forte que acabou a luz no bairro todo.

weather and seasons.text: Aunque el cielo esté despejado, en la montaña el tiempo puede cambiar en cuestión de minutos.
weather and seasons.en: Even if the sky is clear, in the mountains the weather can change in a matter of minutes.
weather and seasons.pt: Mesmo que o céu esteja limpo, na montanha o tempo pode mudar em questão de minutos.

weather and seasons.text: Lo que más echo de menos del verano son las noches largas en la terraza con los amigos.
weather and seasons.en: What I miss most about summer is the long evenings on the terrace with friends.
weather and seasons.pt: O que mais sinto falta do verão são as noites longas no terraço com os amigos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Los sábados por la mañana suelo ir a nadar y después me tomo un café con mis amigas.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Saturday mornings I usually go swimming and then have a coffee with my friends.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Aos sábados de manhã costumo ir nadar e depois tomo um café com minhas amigas.

hobbies and weekends.text: Desde que me apunté a clases de cerámica, paso los domingos con las manos llenas de barro.
hobbies and weekends.en: Since I signed up for pottery classes, I spend my Sundays with my hands covered in clay.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Desde que me inscrevi nas aulas de cerâmica, passo os domingos com as mãos cheias de barro.

hobbies and weekends.text: Si tuviera más tiempo libre, aprendería a tocar el piano, que siempre me ha hecho ilusión.
hobbies and weekends.en: If I had more free time, I'd learn to play the piano, which I've always dreamed of doing.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Se eu tivesse mais tempo livre, aprenderia a tocar piano, que sempre foi um sonho meu.

hobbies and weekends.text: ¿Te apetece que vayamos al cine esta noche o prefieres quedarte en casa viendo una serie?
hobbies and weekends.en: Do you fancy going to the cinema tonight, or would you rather stay in and watch a series?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você está a fim de irmos ao cinema hoje à noite ou prefere ficar em casa vendo uma série?

hobbies and weekends.text: Este fin de semana no pienso hacer nada más que leer y descansar.
hobbies and weekends.en: This weekend I'm not planning to do anything but read and rest.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Neste fim de semana não pretendo fazer nada além de ler e descansar.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mi marido se ha aficionado tanto a la bici que sale todos los domingos a las siete.
hobbies and weekends.en: My husband has got so into cycling that he goes out every Sunday at seven.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu marido pegou tanto gosto pela bicicleta que sai todo domingo às sete.

hobbies and weekends.text: Hicimos una ruta por la sierra de Guadarrama y acabamos agotados, pero mereció la pena.
hobbies and weekends.en: We did a hike in the Guadarrama mountains and ended up exhausted, but it was worth it.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Fizemos uma trilha na serra de Guadarrama e terminamos exaustos, mas valeu a pena.

hobbies and weekends.text: Me encantaría que vinieras conmigo al concierto del sábado, porque me sobra una entrada.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'd love you to come with me to Saturday's concert, because I've got a spare ticket.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu adoraria que você fosse comigo ao show de sábado, porque tenho um ingresso sobrando.

hobbies and weekends.text: Últimamente me ha dado por hacer puzles de mil piezas y no puedo parar.
hobbies and weekends.en: Lately I've got into doing thousand-piece jigsaws and I can't stop.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Ultimamente cismei de montar quebra-cabeças de mil peças e não consigo parar.

hobbies and weekends.text: Cuando hace buen tiempo, solemos ir al campo a hacer una barbacoa con los vecinos.
hobbies and weekends.en: When the weather's nice, we usually go to the countryside for a barbecue with the neighbours.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Quando o tempo está bom, costumamos ir ao campo fazer um churrasco com os vizinhos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mi hijo está obsesionado con los videojuegos, y nos cuesta que salga a jugar fuera.
hobbies and weekends.en: My son is obsessed with video games, and it's hard to get him to go and play outside.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu filho é obcecado por videogame, e é difícil fazer ele sair para brincar lá fora.

hobbies and weekends.text: Llevo dos años en un coro y cantar me ayuda muchísimo a desconectar del trabajo.
hobbies and weekends.en: I've been in a choir for two years and singing really helps me switch off from work.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Estou num coral há dois anos e cantar me ajuda muito a desligar do trabalho.

hobbies and weekends.text: ¿Qué tal si el domingo vamos al Rastro y luego comemos por La Latina?
hobbies and weekends.en: How about going to the Rastro flea market on Sunday and then having lunch around La Latina?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Que tal irmos ao Rastro no domingo e depois almoçarmos pela região de La Latina?

hobbies and weekends.text: Aunque no se me da muy bien, disfruto muchísimo pintando acuarelas en el parque.
hobbies and weekends.en: Although I'm not very good at it, I really enjoy painting watercolours in the park.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Embora eu não seja muito bom nisso, curto muito pintar aquarelas no parque.

hobbies and weekends.text: El fin de semana pasado fuimos a una casa rural y no hicimos absolutamente nada.
hobbies and weekends.en: Last weekend we went to a country cottage and did absolutely nothing.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No fim de semana passado fomos a uma casa de campo e não fizemos absolutamente nada.

hobbies and weekends.text: Me he propuesto leer un libro al mes, aunque de momento voy un poco retrasado.
hobbies and weekends.en: I've set myself the goal of reading a book a month, although I'm a bit behind for now.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Me propus ler um livro por mês, embora por enquanto esteja um pouco atrasado.

hobbies and weekends.text: Si no te gusta el fútbol, podemos ir a ver la exposición de fotografía del Reina Sofía.
hobbies and weekends.en: If you don't like football, we can go and see the photography exhibition at the Reina Sofía.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Se você não gosta de futebol, podemos ir ver a exposição de fotografia do Reina Sofía.

hobbies and weekends.text: Cada domingo quedo con unos amigos para jugar al baloncesto en el polideportivo.
hobbies and weekends.en: Every Sunday I meet up with some friends to play basketball at the sports centre.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Todo domingo encontro uns amigos para jogar basquete no ginásio poliesportivo.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mi abuelo se pasa las tardes jugando al dominó con sus amigos en el hogar del jubilado.
hobbies and weekends.en: My grandfather spends his afternoons playing dominoes with his friends at the senior centre.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Meu avô passa as tardes jogando dominó com os amigos no centro de convivência de idosos.

hobbies and weekends.text: Me gustaría encontrar un hobby que no implicara pasar más horas delante de una pantalla.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'd like to find a hobby that doesn't involve spending more hours in front of a screen.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu gostaria de encontrar um hobby que não envolvesse passar mais horas na frente de uma tela.

hobbies and weekends.text: No sabía que te interesara la fotografía, y menos que tuvieras una cámara tan buena.
hobbies and weekends.en: I didn't know you were interested in photography, let alone that you had such a good camera.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu não sabia que você se interessava por fotografia, muito menos que tinha uma câmera tão boa.

hobbies and weekends.text: Este sábado hay un mercadillo de libros de segunda mano en la plaza del pueblo.
hobbies and weekends.en: This Saturday there's a second-hand book market in the village square.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Neste sábado tem uma feira de livros usados na praça da cidade.

hobbies and weekends.text: Desde que tenemos perro, los fines de semana salimos mucho más al campo.
hobbies and weekends.en: Since we got a dog, we get out into the countryside much more at weekends.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Desde que temos cachorro, nos fins de semana saímos muito mais para o campo.

hobbies and weekends.text: Cuando era joven jugaba al ajedrez en un club, pero lo dejé al empezar a trabajar.
hobbies and weekends.en: When I was young I played chess at a club, but I gave it up when I started working.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Quando eu era jovem, jogava xadrez num clube, mas parei quando comecei a trabalhar.

hobbies and weekends.text: Ojalá el domingo no llueva, porque tenemos entradas para ver al Betis en el estadio.
hobbies and weekends.en: I hope it doesn't rain on Sunday, because we've got tickets to see Betis at the stadium.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Tomara que não chova no domingo, porque temos ingressos para ver o Betis no estádio.

hobbies and weekends.text: A Clara le encanta cocinar, así que los domingos siempre prepara algo nuevo para toda la familia.
hobbies and weekends.en: Clara loves cooking, so on Sundays she always makes something new for the whole family.
hobbies and weekends.pt: A Clara adora cozinhar, então aos domingos sempre prepara algo novo para a família toda.

hobbies and weekends.text: No hay nada que me relaje más que pasar una tarde entera pescando en el río.
hobbies and weekends.en: There's nothing that relaxes me more than spending a whole afternoon fishing on the river.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Não há nada que me relaxe mais do que passar uma tarde inteira pescando no rio.

hobbies and weekends.text: Nos hemos apuntado a clases de salsa los viernes por la noche y nos lo pasamos genial.
hobbies and weekends.en: We've signed up for salsa classes on Friday nights and we're having a great time.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Nos inscrevemos em aulas de salsa às sextas à noite e estamos nos divertindo muito.

hobbies and weekends.text: ¿Has visto la última película de Almodóvar o todavía no ha llegado a los cines de tu ciudad?
hobbies and weekends.en: Have you seen the latest Almodóvar film, or hasn't it reached the cinemas in your city yet?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Você já viu o último filme do Almodóvar ou ele ainda não chegou aos cinemas da sua cidade?

hobbies and weekends.text: El domingo me levanté tardísimo, desayuné tranquilamente y me pasé la tarde en el sofá.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Sunday I got up really late, had a leisurely breakfast and spent the afternoon on the sofa.
hobbies and weekends.pt: No domingo acordei muito tarde, tomei café com calma e passei a tarde no sofá.

hobbies and weekends.text: Me he comprado una guitarra de segunda mano y estoy aprendiendo con vídeos de internet.
hobbies and weekends.en: I've bought a second-hand guitar and I'm learning with online videos.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Comprei um violão usado e estou aprendendo com vídeos da internet.

hobbies and weekends.text: Para que los niños se desfogaran un poco, los llevamos al parque de atracciones el sábado.
hobbies and weekends.en: So the kids could let off some steam, we took them to the theme park on Saturday.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Para as crianças gastarem um pouco de energia, levamos elas ao parque de diversões no sábado.

hobbies and weekends.text: Siempre que tengo un fin de semana libre, aprovecho para escaparme a algún pueblo con encanto.
hobbies and weekends.en: Whenever I have a free weekend, I take the chance to get away to some charming village.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Sempre que tenho um fim de semana livre, aproveito para fugir para alguma cidadezinha charmosa.

hobbies and weekends.text: No entiendo cómo te puede gustar correr maratones, porque a mí me parece una tortura.
hobbies and weekends.en: I don't understand how you can enjoy running marathons, because to me it seems like torture.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Não entendo como você pode gostar de correr maratonas, porque para mim parece uma tortura.

hobbies and weekends.text: Mi pareja y yo estamos haciendo un curso de cocina japonesa los martes por la tarde.
hobbies and weekends.en: My partner and I are doing a Japanese cooking course on Tuesday evenings.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu e meu parceiro estamos fazendo um curso de culinária japonesa às terças à tarde.

hobbies and weekends.text: Este verano quiero aprender a hacer surf, aunque el mar me da un poco de miedo.
hobbies and weekends.en: This summer I want to learn to surf, although the sea scares me a little.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Neste verão quero aprender a surfar, embora o mar me dê um pouco de medo.

hobbies and weekends.text: Los viernes por la noche quedamos para jugar a juegos de mesa y pedimos unas pizzas.
hobbies and weekends.en: On Friday nights we get together to play board games and order some pizzas.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Às sextas à noite nos reunimos para jogar jogos de tabuleiro e pedimos umas pizzas.

hobbies and weekends.text: Me encantaría hacer voluntariado los fines de semana, pero aún no he encontrado ninguna asociación cerca.
hobbies and weekends.en: I'd love to volunteer at weekends, but I haven't found an organisation nearby yet.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Eu adoraria fazer trabalho voluntário nos fins de semana, mas ainda não encontrei nenhuma associação por perto.

hobbies and weekends.text: ¿Quieres que te enseñe a hacer punto, que es más relajante de lo que parece?
hobbies and weekends.en: Do you want me to teach you to knit, since it's more relaxing than it looks?
hobbies and weekends.pt: Quer que eu te ensine a tricotar, que é mais relaxante do que parece?

hobbies and weekends.text: Cuando mis amigos y yo nos juntamos para ver el partido, siempre acabamos discutiendo de fútbol.
hobbies and weekends.en: Whenever my friends and I get together to watch the match, we always end up arguing about football.
hobbies and weekends.pt: Quando eu e meus amigos nos juntamos para ver o jogo, sempre acabamos discutindo sobre futebol.

home and daily routine.text: Entre semana me levanto a las seis y media para que me dé tiempo a desayunar tranquilo.
home and daily routine.en: On weekdays I get up at half past six so I have time for a relaxed breakfast.
home and daily routine.pt: Durante a semana acordo às seis e meia para dar tempo de tomar café com calma.

home and daily routine.text: Si llegas a casa antes que yo, ¿podrías poner la lavadora y tender la ropa?
home and daily routine.en: If you get home before me, could you put a wash on and hang the clothes out?
home and daily routine.pt: Se você chegar em casa antes de mim, poderia colocar a roupa para lavar e depois estender?

home and daily routine.text: En casa nos repartimos las tareas: yo cocino y mi pareja friega los platos.
home and daily routine.en: At home we share the chores: I cook and my partner does the dishes.
home and daily routine.pt: Em casa dividimos as tarefas: eu cozinho e meu parceiro lava a louça.

home and daily routine.text: Desde que trabajo en casa, me cuesta mucho separar la vida personal del trabajo.
home and daily routine.en: Since I started working at home, I find it really hard to separate my personal life from work.
home and daily routine.pt: Desde que trabalho em casa, tenho muita dificuldade em separar a vida pessoal do trabalho.

home and daily routine.text: Antes de acostarme, siempre dejo preparada la ropa que me voy a poner al día siguiente.
home and daily routine.en: Before going to bed, I always lay out the clothes I'm going to wear the next day.
home and daily routine.pt: Antes de dormir, sempre deixo separada a roupa que vou vestir no dia seguinte.

home and daily routine.text: Hay que llamar al fontanero cuanto antes, porque el grifo de la cocina no deja de gotear.
home and daily routine.en: We need to call the plumber as soon as possible, because the kitchen tap won't stop dripping.
home and daily routine.pt: Precisamos chamar o encanador o quanto antes, porque a torneira da cozinha não para de pingar.

home and daily routine.text: No soporto que dejes los calcetines tirados por el suelo del salón.
home and daily routine.en: I can't stand you leaving your socks lying around on the living room floor.
home and daily routine.pt: Não suporto que você deixe as meias jogadas no chão da sala.

home and daily routine.text: Los domingos por la tarde aprovecho para hacer la compra de toda la semana y cocinar.
home and daily routine.en: On Sunday afternoons I take the chance to do the whole week's shopping and cook.
home and daily routine.pt: Aos domingos à tarde aproveito para fazer as compras da semana toda e cozinhar.

home and daily routine.text: Mi rutina cambió por completo cuando empecé a ir al gimnasio antes del trabajo.
home and daily routine.en: My routine changed completely when I started going to the gym before work.
home and daily routine.pt: Minha rotina mudou completamente quando comecei a ir à academia antes do trabalho.

home and daily routine.text: ¿Te importaría bajar la basura cuando salgas, que yo tengo las manos ocupadas?
home and daily routine.en: Would you mind taking the rubbish down when you go out, as my hands are full?
home and daily routine.pt: Você se importaria de levar o lixo quando sair, que estou com as mãos ocupadas?

home and daily routine.text: Queremos pintar el piso antes de que nazca el bebé, pero no encontramos el momento.
home and daily routine.en: We want to paint the flat before the baby is born, but we can't find the time.
home and daily routine.pt: Queremos pintar o apartamento antes que o bebê nasça, mas não achamos tempo.

home and daily routine.text: Por las mañanas no soy persona hasta que me tomo el primer café.
home and daily routine.en: In the mornings I'm not human until I've had my first coffee.
home and daily routine.pt: De manhã eu não sou gente até tomar o primeiro café.

home and daily routine.text: Cada vez que salta la luz, tengo que bajar al sótano para revisar el cuadro eléctrico.
home and daily routine.en: Every time the power trips, I have to go down to the basement to check the fuse box.
home and daily routine.pt: Toda vez que a energia cai, tenho que descer ao porão para verificar o quadro de luz.

home and daily routine.text: Si no ordenas tu cuarto antes de cenar, mañana no saldrás con tus amigos.
home and daily routine.en: If you don't tidy your room before dinner, you won't be going out with your friends tomorrow.
home and daily routine.pt: Se você não arrumar o quarto antes do jantar, amanhã não vai sair com os amigos.

home and daily routine.text: Me he acostumbrado a dormir la siesta los fines de semana y ya no puedo vivir sin ella.
home and daily routine.en: I've got used to having a nap at weekends and now I can't live without it.
home and daily routine.pt: Me acostumei a tirar uma soneca nos fins de semana e agora não consigo viver sem ela.

home and daily routine.text: Al volver del trabajo, lo primero que hago es quitarme los zapatos y ponerme cómodo.
home and daily routine.en: When I get back from work, the first thing I do is take off my shoes and get comfortable.
home and daily routine.pt: Ao voltar do trabalho, a primeira coisa que faço é tirar os sapatos e ficar à vontade.

home and daily routine.text: Nuestro piso es pequeño, pero tiene mucha luz y unas vistas preciosas a la sierra.
home and daily routine.en: Our flat is small, but it gets lots of light and has lovely views of the mountains.
home and daily routine.pt: Nosso apartamento é pequeno, mas tem muita luz e uma vista linda para a serra.

home and daily routine.text: ¿Quién se ha dejado la ventana del baño abierta toda la noche, con el frío que hace?
home and daily routine.en: Who left the bathroom window open all night, in this cold?
home and daily routine.pt: Quem deixou a janela do banheiro aberta a noite toda, com esse frio?

home and daily routine.text: Aunque odio planchar, prefiero hacerlo el domingo que tenerlo pendiente toda la semana.
home and daily routine.en: Although I hate ironing, I'd rather do it on Sunday than have it hanging over me all week.
home and daily routine.pt: Embora eu odeie passar roupa, prefiro fazer isso no domingo a ficar com isso pendente a semana toda.

home and daily routine.text: Antes de salir, comprueba que has apagado el horno y has cerrado la puerta con llave.
home and daily routine.en: Before you leave, check that you've turned off the oven and locked the door.
home and daily routine.pt: Antes de sair, confira se você desligou o forno e trancou a porta.

home and daily routine.text: Mis hijos tardan tanto en vestirse que casi todos los días llegamos tarde al colegio.
home and daily routine.en: My kids take so long to get dressed that we're late for school almost every day.
home and daily routine.pt: Meus filhos demoram tanto para se vestir que quase todo dia chegamos atrasados na escola.

home and daily routine.text: Estamos pensando en reformar la cocina, aunque nos da pereza vivir entre obras varios meses.
home and daily routine.en: We're thinking of redoing the kitchen, although we can't face living with building work for months.
home and daily routine.pt: Estamos pensando em reformar a cozinha, embora dê preguiça viver no meio de obra por vários meses.

home and daily routine.text: Me levanto, me ducho, desayuno algo rápido y salgo corriendo a coger el autobús de las ocho.
home and daily routine.en: I get up, have a shower, grab a quick breakfast and rush out to catch the eight o'clock bus.
home and daily routine.pt: Eu acordo, tomo banho, como algo rápido e saio correndo para pegar o ônibus das oito.

home and daily routine.text: Es mejor que pongas el lavavajillas por la noche, que la luz sale más barata.
home and daily routine.en: It's better to run the dishwasher at night, as electricity is cheaper then.
home and daily routine.pt: É melhor ligar a lava-louças à noite, que a energia sai mais barata.

home and daily routine.text: Desde que tenemos robot aspirador, ya no discutimos por quién tiene que barrer.
home and daily routine.en: Since we got a robot vacuum, we no longer argue about who has to sweep.
home and daily routine.pt: Desde que temos aspirador robô, não discutimos mais sobre quem tem que varrer.

home and daily routine.text: Cuando vivía con mis padres, nunca me preocupaba de las facturas ni de la limpieza.
home and daily routine.en: When I lived with my parents, I never worried about bills or cleaning.
home and daily routine.pt: Quando eu morava com meus pais, nunca me preocupava com contas nem com limpeza.

home and daily routine.text: ¿Podrías darle de comer al gato mientras estoy de viaje si te dejo las llaves?
home and daily routine.en: Could you feed the cat while I'm away if I leave you the keys?
home and daily routine.pt: Você poderia dar comida para o gato enquanto eu estiver viajando se eu deixar as chaves com você?

home and daily routine.text: Me cuesta muchísimo madrugar en invierno, cuando todavía es de noche al salir de casa.
home and daily routine.en: I find it really hard to get up early in winter, when it's still dark as I leave the house.
home and daily routine.pt: Tenho muita dificuldade em acordar cedo no inverno, quando ainda está escuro ao sair de casa.

home and daily routine.text: La calefacción lleva dos días sin funcionar y el técnico no puede venir hasta el jueves.
home and daily routine.en: The heating hasn't worked for two days and the technician can't come until Thursday.
home and daily routine.pt: O aquecimento está sem funcionar há dois dias e o técnico só pode vir na quinta.

home and daily routine.text: Después de cenar solemos ver un capítulo de alguna serie antes de irnos a dormir.
home and daily routine.en: After dinner we usually watch an episode of a series before going to bed.
home and daily routine.pt: Depois do jantar costumamos ver um episódio de alguma série antes de ir dormir.

home and daily routine.text: Ojalá tuviéramos un balcón, porque me encantaría desayunar al aire libre.
home and daily routine.en: I wish we had a balcony, because I'd love to have breakfast outdoors.
home and daily routine.pt: Quem dera tivéssemos uma varanda, porque eu adoraria tomar café da manhã ao ar livre.

home and daily routine.text: En mi casa cenamos tardísimo, casi nunca antes de las diez de la noche.
home and daily routine.en: At home we have dinner really late, hardly ever before ten at night.
home and daily routine.pt: Na minha casa jantamos muito tarde, quase nunca antes das dez da noite.

home and daily routine.text: Si no hubieras dejado la puerta de la nevera abierta, no se habría estropeado el pescado.
home and daily routine.en: If you hadn't left the fridge door open, the fish wouldn't have gone off.
home and daily routine.pt: Se você não tivesse deixado a porta da geladeira aberta, o peixe não teria estragado.

home and daily routine.text: Por mucho que limpie, con dos gatos en casa siempre hay pelos por todas partes.
home and daily routine.en: However much I clean, with two cats in the house there's always hair everywhere.
home and daily routine.pt: Por mais que eu limpe, com dois gatos em casa sempre tem pelo por todo lado.

home and daily routine.text: Estoy intentando acostarme antes de las once para no ir tan cansado al trabajo.
home and daily routine.en: I'm trying to go to bed before eleven so I'm not so tired at work.
home and daily routine.pt: Estou tentando deitar antes das onze para não ir tão cansado para o trabalho.

home and daily routine.text: Los lunes saco a pasear al perro antes de que amanezca, porque luego no tengo tiempo.
home and daily routine.en: On Mondays I walk the dog before dawn, because later on I don't have time.
home and daily routine.pt: Às segundas levo o cachorro para passear antes de amanhecer, porque depois não tenho tempo.

home and daily routine.text: ¿Dónde has puesto las llaves del coche, que llevo diez minutos buscándolas?
home and daily routine.en: Where have you put the car keys, because I've been looking for them for ten minutes?
home and daily routine.pt: Onde você colocou as chaves do carro, que estou procurando há dez minutos?

home and daily routine.text: Compartir piso con tres personas tiene sus ventajas, aunque a veces echo de menos la intimidad.
home and daily routine.en: Sharing a flat with three people has its advantages, although sometimes I miss my privacy.
home and daily routine.pt: Dividir apartamento com três pessoas tem suas vantagens, embora às vezes eu sinta falta de privacidade.

home and daily routine.text: Cuando acabemos de recoger la cocina, nos sentamos un rato en el sofá a charlar.
home and daily routine.en: When we've finished tidying the kitchen, we'll sit on the sofa for a while and chat.
home and daily routine.pt: Quando terminarmos de arrumar a cozinha, a gente senta um pouco no sofá para conversar.

home and daily routine.text: Mi madre siempre decía que una casa ordenada es una mente ordenada, y empiezo a darle la razón.
home and daily routine.en: My mother always said that a tidy house is a tidy mind, and I'm starting to agree with her.
home and daily routine.pt: Minha mãe sempre dizia que casa arrumada é mente arrumada, e estou começando a dar razão a ela.

feelings and opinions.text: Me molesta muchísimo que la gente hable por el móvil en voz alta en el tren.
feelings and opinions.en: It really annoys me when people talk loudly on their phones on the train.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me incomoda muito que as pessoas falem alto no celular no trem.

feelings and opinions.text: No creo que sea justo juzgar a alguien sin conocer toda la historia.
feelings and opinions.en: I don't think it's fair to judge someone without knowing the whole story.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não acho justo julgar alguém sem conhecer a história toda.

feelings and opinions.text: Me puse tan nervioso en la entrevista que se me olvidó hasta mi número de teléfono.
feelings and opinions.en: I got so nervous in the interview that I even forgot my own phone number.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fiquei tão nervoso na entrevista que esqueci até meu número de telefone.

feelings and opinions.text: Sinceramente, me parece que exageras, porque no creo que lo dijera con mala intención.
feelings and opinions.en: Honestly, I think you're exaggerating, because I don't think he meant it badly.
feelings and opinions.pt: Sinceramente, acho que você está exagerando, porque não acho que ele tenha dito por mal.

feelings and opinions.text: Me hace mucha ilusión que vengas a verme a Valencia este verano.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm really excited that you're coming to see me in Valencia this summer.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou muito animado que você venha me visitar em Valência neste verão.

feelings and opinions.text: Estoy harto de que todo el mundo me cuente sus problemas y nadie me pregunte cómo estoy.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm fed up with everyone telling me their problems and nobody asking how I am.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou cansado de todo mundo me contar seus problemas e ninguém me perguntar como estou.

feelings and opinions.text: A mi modo de ver, deberían invertir más en transporte público y menos en carreteras.
feelings and opinions.en: The way I see it, they should invest more in public transport and less in roads.
feelings and opinions.pt: Do meu ponto de vista, deveriam investir mais em transporte público e menos em estradas.

feelings and opinions.text: Me dio muchísima vergüenza cuando me di cuenta de que había llamado a mi jefe por otro nombre.
feelings and opinions.en: I was so embarrassed when I realised I'd called my boss by the wrong name.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fiquei com muita vergonha quando percebi que tinha chamado meu chefe por outro nome.

feelings and opinions.text: ¿De verdad te parece buena idea dejar el trabajo sin tener otro?
feelings and opinions.en: Do you really think it's a good idea to quit your job without having another one?
feelings and opinions.pt: Você acha mesmo uma boa ideia largar o emprego sem ter outro?

feelings and opinions.text: Me tranquiliza saber que, decida lo que decida, mi familia me va a apoyar.
feelings and opinions.en: It reassures me to know that, whatever I decide, my family will support me.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me tranquiliza saber que, seja qual for minha decisão, minha família vai me apoiar.

feelings and opinions.text: Lo que más me preocupa es que los jóvenes no puedan permitirse alquilar un piso.
feelings and opinions.en: What worries me most is that young people can't afford to rent a flat.
feelings and opinions.pt: O que mais me preocupa é que os jovens não consigam pagar o aluguel de um apartamento.

feelings and opinions.text: Estaba convencida de que no me darían la beca, así que cuando me llamaron me eché a llorar.
feelings and opinions.en: I was convinced I wouldn't get the grant, so when they called me I burst into tears.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu estava convencida de que não ia ganhar a bolsa, então quando me ligaram caí no choro.

feelings and opinions.text: Puede que tengas razón, pero yo lo veo de otra manera.
feelings and opinions.en: You may be right, but I see it differently.
feelings and opinions.pt: Pode ser que você tenha razão, mas eu vejo de outra forma.

feelings and opinions.text: Me da mucha rabia que me interrumpan cuando estoy explicando algo importante.
feelings and opinions.en: It really makes me angry when people interrupt me while I'm explaining something important.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me dá muita raiva quando me interrompem enquanto estou explicando algo importante.

feelings and opinions.text: No me esperaba que la película fuera tan buena, y la verdad es que me emocionó.
feelings and opinions.en: I didn't expect the film to be so good, and to be honest it really moved me.
feelings and opinions.pt: Eu não esperava que o filme fosse tão bom, e a verdade é que me emocionou.

feelings and opinions.text: Estoy de acuerdo contigo en lo esencial, aunque no en todos los detalles.
feelings and opinions.en: I agree with you on the essentials, though not on every detail.
feelings and opinions.pt: Concordo com você no essencial, embora não em todos os detalhes.

feelings and opinions.text: Desde que me mudé, me siento mucho más tranquila y tengo menos ansiedad.
feelings and opinions.en: Since I moved, I feel much calmer and I have less anxiety.
feelings and opinions.pt: Desde que me mudei, me sinto muito mais tranquila e tenho menos ansiedade.

feelings and opinions.text: ¿No te da miedo viajar sola por países que no conoces?
feelings and opinions.en: Aren't you scared of travelling alone in countries you don't know?
feelings and opinions.pt: Você não tem medo de viajar sozinha por países que não conhece?

feelings and opinions.text: Me sentí fatal por no haber ido a su cumpleaños, así que le mandé un regalo.
feelings and opinions.en: I felt terrible about missing her birthday, so I sent her a present.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me senti péssimo por não ter ido ao aniversário dela, então mandei um presente.

feelings and opinions.text: Que yo sepa, nadie se ha quejado del nuevo horario, así que no entiendo el problema.
feelings and opinions.en: As far as I know, nobody has complained about the new timetable, so I don't see the problem.
feelings and opinions.pt: Que eu saiba, ninguém reclamou do novo horário, então não entendo o problema.

feelings and opinions.text: Me encanta que la gente sea sincera, aunque a veces la verdad duela.
feelings and opinions.en: I love it when people are honest, even if the truth sometimes hurts.
feelings and opinions.pt: Adoro quando as pessoas são sinceras, mesmo que às vezes a verdade doa.

feelings and opinions.text: Para mí, lo más importante de un trabajo es que te deje tiempo para tu vida.
feelings and opinions.en: For me, the most important thing about a job is that it leaves you time for your own life.
feelings and opinions.pt: Para mim, o mais importante num trabalho é que ele te deixe tempo para a sua vida.

feelings and opinions.text: Me sorprende que todavía haya gente que no recicle, con lo fácil que es hoy en día.
feelings and opinions.en: It surprises me that there are still people who don't recycle, given how easy it is nowadays.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me surpreende que ainda haja gente que não recicla, sendo tão fácil hoje em dia.

feelings and opinions.text: Cuando me enteré de la noticia, no supe si reír o llorar.
feelings and opinions.en: When I heard the news, I didn't know whether to laugh or cry.
feelings and opinions.pt: Quando fiquei sabendo da notícia, não soube se ria ou chorava.

feelings and opinions.text: Tengo la sensación de que últimamente todo el mundo va con prisa y nadie disfruta de nada.
feelings and opinions.en: I get the feeling that lately everyone's in a hurry and nobody enjoys anything.
feelings and opinions.pt: Tenho a sensação de que ultimamente todo mundo anda com pressa e ninguém aproveita nada.

feelings and opinions.text: No es que no me guste tu idea, es que creo que todavía no es el momento.
feelings and opinions.en: It's not that I don't like your idea; it's that I don't think the time is right yet.
feelings and opinions.pt: Não é que eu não goste da sua ideia, é que acho que ainda não é o momento.

feelings and opinions.text: Me pone de muy buen humor salir a correr temprano y ver amanecer junto al mar.
feelings and opinions.en: Going for an early run and watching the sunrise by the sea puts me in a really good mood.
feelings and opinions.pt: Sair para correr cedo e ver o sol nascer à beira-mar me deixa de muito bom humor.

feelings and opinions.text: Admiro mucho a mi tía Pilar porque siempre ha luchado por lo que quería.
feelings and opinions.en: I really admire my aunt Pilar because she has always fought for what she wanted.
feelings and opinions.pt: Admiro muito minha tia Pilar porque ela sempre lutou pelo que queria.

feelings and opinions.text: Aunque al principio me costó adaptarme, ahora no cambiaría esta ciudad por nada.
feelings and opinions.en: Although it was hard to adapt at first, now I wouldn't swap this city for anything.
feelings and opinions.pt: Embora no começo tenha sido difícil me adaptar, agora não trocaria esta cidade por nada.

feelings and opinions.text: Me parece fatal que hayan cerrado la biblioteca del barrio para construir un aparcamiento.
feelings and opinions.en: I think it's terrible that they've closed the local library to build a car park.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho péssimo que tenham fechado a biblioteca do bairro para construir um estacionamento.

feelings and opinions.text: ¿Qué opinas de que los niños tengan móvil antes de cumplir los doce años?
feelings and opinions.en: What do you think about children having mobile phones before they turn twelve?
feelings and opinions.pt: O que você acha de as crianças terem celular antes de completarem doze anos?

feelings and opinions.text: Estoy muy orgulloso de mi hija, que ha aprobado las oposiciones a la primera.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm very proud of my daughter, who passed the civil service exams at the first attempt.
feelings and opinions.pt: Estou muito orgulhoso da minha filha, que passou no concurso público de primeira.

feelings and opinions.text: Siento mucho lo que pasó el otro día, porque no era mi intención hacerte daño.
feelings and opinions.en: I'm really sorry about what happened the other day, because I never meant to hurt you.
feelings and opinions.pt: Sinto muito pelo que aconteceu outro dia, porque não era minha intenção te magoar.

feelings and opinions.text: Me agobia muchísimo tener tantas cosas pendientes y no saber por dónde empezar.
feelings and opinions.en: It really stresses me out to have so many things to do and not know where to start.
feelings and opinions.pt: Me angustia muito ter tantas coisas pendentes e não saber por onde começar.

feelings and opinions.text: Francamente, no entiendo por qué te molesta tanto que tu hermano opine diferente.
feelings and opinions.en: Frankly, I don't understand why it bothers you so much that your brother thinks differently.
feelings and opinions.pt: Francamente, não entendo por que te incomoda tanto que seu irmão pense diferente.

feelings and opinions.text: Me quedé de piedra cuando me dijeron que Jorge y Ana se habían separado.
feelings and opinions.en: I was stunned when they told me that Jorge and Ana had split up.
feelings and opinions.pt: Fiquei de queixo caído quando me disseram que o Jorge e a Ana tinham se separado.

feelings and opinions.text: Por un lado me apetece cambiar de aires, pero por otro me da pena dejar a mis amigos.
feelings and opinions.en: On the one hand I fancy a change of scene, but on the other I'm sad to leave my friends.
feelings and opinions.pt: Por um lado estou a fim de mudar de ares, mas por outro me dá pena deixar meus amigos.

feelings and opinions.text: Dudo mucho que el Gobierno cumpla todo lo que prometió en la campaña.
feelings and opinions.en: I very much doubt the government will deliver everything it promised in the campaign.
feelings and opinions.pt: Duvido muito que o governo cumpra tudo o que prometeu na campanha.

feelings and opinions.text: ¡Qué alegría me da verte tan recuperado después de todo lo que has pasado!
feelings and opinions.en: I'm so happy to see you so well recovered after everything you've been through!
feelings and opinions.pt: Que alegria te ver tão recuperado depois de tudo o que você passou!

feelings and opinions.text: Creo que la felicidad está en las cosas pequeñas, como una buena charla con los amigos.
feelings and opinions.en: I think happiness lies in the little things, like a good chat with friends.
feelings and opinions.pt: Acho que a felicidade está nas pequenas coisas, como uma boa conversa com os amigos.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Buenos días, Manuel, ¿qué tal le fue a su hija en el examen de conducir?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Good morning, Manuel, how did your daughter get on in her driving test?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Bom dia, Manuel, como sua filha se saiu na prova de direção?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Perdone que le moleste, pero ¿sabe si han arreglado ya el ascensor?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Sorry to bother you, but do you know if they've fixed the lift yet?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Desculpe incomodar, mas o senhor sabe se já consertaram o elevador?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Con el calor que ha hecho esta noche, no he podido pegar ojo, ¿y usted?
small talk with a neighbour.en: With how hot it was last night, I didn't sleep a wink; how about you?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Com o calor que fez esta noite, não consegui pregar o olho, e o senhor?

small talk with a neighbour.text: He visto que tienen un perro nuevo; ¿cómo se llama y cuántos meses tiene?
small talk with a neighbour.en: I see you've got a new dog; what's its name and how many months old is it?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vi que vocês têm um cachorro novo; como ele se chama e quantos meses tem?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Si necesita que le riegue las plantas mientras está fuera, no dude en decírmelo.
small talk with a neighbour.en: If you need me to water your plants while you're away, don't hesitate to ask.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Se precisar que eu regue suas plantas enquanto estiver fora, não hesite em me dizer.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Se ha enterado de que van a abrir un supermercado nuevo en la esquina?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you heard they're going to open a new supermarket on the corner?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor ficou sabendo que vão abrir um supermercado novo na esquina?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Disculpe el ruido de ayer, que celebramos el cumpleaños de mi hijo y se nos hizo tarde.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Sorry about the noise yesterday; we were celebrating my son's birthday and it got late.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Desculpe o barulho de ontem, é que comemoramos o aniversário do meu filho e acabou ficando tarde.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Hace siglos que no le veía, ¿ha estado usted de viaje?
small talk with a neighbour.en: I haven't seen you for ages; have you been away?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Faz séculos que não vejo o senhor, estava viajando?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Me han dicho que la comunidad va a subir la cuota para pintar la fachada.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I've been told the residents' association is going to raise the fees to paint the front of the building.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Me disseram que o condomínio vai aumentar a taxa para pintar a fachada.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¡Qué mayor está su nieto, si la última vez que lo vi todavía era un bebé!
small talk with a neighbour.en: How grown-up your grandson is, when the last time I saw him he was still a baby!
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Como seu neto está grande, e da última vez que o vi ainda era um bebê!

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Le importaría avisarme si ve que llega un paquete a mi nombre esta tarde?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Would you mind letting me know if you see a parcel arrive in my name this afternoon?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor se importaria de me avisar se vir chegar um pacote no meu nome hoje à tarde?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Parece que por fin ha llegado la primavera; ya era hora de ver un poco de sol.
small talk with a neighbour.en: It looks like spring has finally arrived; it was about time we saw some sun.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Parece que finalmente a primavera chegou; já era hora de ver um pouco de sol.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Qué tal se han adaptado los niños al nuevo colegio?
small talk with a neighbour.en: How have the children settled into their new school?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Como as crianças se adaptaram à escola nova?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Oiga, ¿sabe usted a qué hora pasa el camión de la basura los sábados?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Excuse me, do you know what time the bin lorry comes on Saturdays?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Escuta, o senhor sabe a que horas passa o caminhão de lixo aos sábados?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ya me he enterado de lo de su marido; si necesita cualquier cosa, aquí me tiene.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I've heard about your husband; if you need anything at all, I'm here for you.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Já fiquei sabendo do que aconteceu com seu marido; se precisar de qualquer coisa, pode contar comigo.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Mire, le he traído unos tomates de mi huerto, que este año hemos tenido muchísimos.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Look, I've brought you some tomatoes from my vegetable patch, as we've had loads this year.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Olha, trouxe uns tomates da minha horta para o senhor, que este ano tivemos muitos.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Sabe qué obras están haciendo en el piso de abajo, que llevan una semana con el taladro?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you know what work they're doing in the flat downstairs, because they've been drilling for a week?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor sabe que obra estão fazendo no apartamento de baixo, que estão há uma semana com a furadeira?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Me alegro de que se haya recuperado tan rápido de la operación de rodilla.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I'm glad you've recovered so quickly from your knee operation.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Fico feliz que o senhor tenha se recuperado tão rápido da cirurgia no joelho.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Va usted también a la reunión de vecinos del jueves por la tarde?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Are you going to the residents' meeting on Thursday afternoon too?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor também vai à reunião de condomínio de quinta à tarde?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le dejo mi número por si alguna vez necesita algo o pasa cualquier cosa en el edificio.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I'll leave you my number in case you ever need anything or something happens in the building.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vou deixar meu número caso o senhor precise de algo ou aconteça qualquer coisa no prédio.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Por lo que me han contado, los nuevos vecinos del tercero son una pareja de Argentina.
small talk with a neighbour.en: From what I've been told, the new neighbours on the third floor are a couple from Argentina.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Pelo que me contaram, os novos vizinhos do terceiro andar são um casal da Argentina.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Qué está cocinando hoy, que huele de maravilla desde el rellano?
small talk with a neighbour.en: What are you cooking today, because it smells wonderful from the landing?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O que a senhora está cozinhando hoje, que está com um cheiro maravilhoso lá do corredor?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Espero que el perro no les moleste por las noches, que está aprendiendo a quedarse solo.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I hope the dog doesn't bother you at night; he's learning to stay on his own.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Espero que o cachorro não incomode vocês à noite, que ele está aprendendo a ficar sozinho.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Va a ir al pueblo este verano o se queda en Madrid como el año pasado?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Are you going to your village this summer, or staying in Madrid like last year?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor vai para a sua cidade natal neste verão ou vai ficar em Madri como no ano passado?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Me ha dicho el portero que mañana cortarán el agua de diez a doce.
small talk with a neighbour.en: The caretaker told me they'll cut off the water tomorrow from ten to twelve.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O porteiro me disse que amanhã vão cortar a água das dez ao meio-dia.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Si quiere, le ayudo a subir las bolsas, que pesan bastante.
small talk with a neighbour.en: If you like, I'll help you carry the bags up, as they're quite heavy.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Se quiser, eu ajudo o senhor a subir com as sacolas, que estão bem pesadas.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Vaya tiempo más raro estamos teniendo este otoño, ¿no le parece?
small talk with a neighbour.en: What strange weather we're having this autumn, don't you think?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Que tempo mais estranho estamos tendo neste outono, não acha?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Su hija toca el violín muy bien; a veces la escuchamos practicar por las tardes.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Your daughter plays the violin very well; sometimes we hear her practising in the afternoons.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Sua filha toca violino muito bem; às vezes a gente ouve ela ensaiar à tarde.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Sabe si alguien ha avisado ya al administrador de la gotera del garaje?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you know if anyone has told the property manager about the leak in the garage yet?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor sabe se alguém já avisou o síndico sobre a goteira na garagem?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Tienen ustedes una terraza muy soleada, y se nota en lo bonitos que están los geranios.
small talk with a neighbour.en: You've got a very sunny terrace, and it shows in how lovely the geraniums look.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Vocês têm um terraço muito ensolarado, e dá para ver pelos gerânios lindos.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Cuando vuelva de vacaciones, tenemos que tomarnos un café y me cuenta qué tal.
small talk with a neighbour.en: When you're back from holiday, we must have a coffee and you can tell me all about it.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Quando o senhor voltar das férias, temos que tomar um café e o senhor me conta como foi.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Le he cogido el correo estos días porque el buzón ya no cerraba de lo lleno que estaba.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I've been collecting your post these last few days because the letterbox was so full it wouldn't close.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Peguei sua correspondência nestes dias porque a caixa de correio já não fechava de tão cheia.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Usted también ha notado que el portal está más sucio desde que cambiaron la empresa de limpieza?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Have you also noticed that the entrance hall is dirtier since they changed the cleaning company?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor também reparou que a portaria está mais suja desde que trocaram a empresa de limpeza?

small talk with a neighbour.text: Dígale a su mujer que muchas gracias por el bizcocho, que estaba buenísimo.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Tell your wife thank you so much for the sponge cake, it was delicious.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Diga à sua esposa que muito obrigado pelo bolo, que estava uma delícia.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Ahora que se ha jubilado, supongo que tendrá mucho más tiempo para sus cosas.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Now that you've retired, I suppose you'll have much more time for your own things.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Agora que o senhor se aposentou, imagino que vai ter muito mais tempo para as suas coisas.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Si oye ruidos raros en mi piso este fin de semana, no se preocupe, que son los pintores.
small talk with a neighbour.en: If you hear strange noises in my flat this weekend, don't worry, it's just the painters.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Se ouvir barulhos estranhos no meu apartamento neste fim de semana, não se preocupe, são os pintores.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Mi hijo dice que su nieto y él van juntos a clase de inglés.
small talk with a neighbour.en: My son says that he and your grandson go to English class together.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Meu filho diz que ele e seu neto fazem aula de inglês juntos.

small talk with a neighbour.text: ¿Cree usted que deberíamos poner cámaras en la entrada después de los robos del mes pasado?
small talk with a neighbour.en: Do you think we should put cameras at the entrance after last month's break-ins?
small talk with a neighbour.pt: O senhor acha que deveríamos colocar câmeras na entrada depois dos roubos do mês passado?

small talk with a neighbour.text: No sabía que usted también fuera del Atleti; tenemos que ver algún partido juntos.
small talk with a neighbour.en: I didn't know you were an Atlético fan too; we must watch a match together.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Eu não sabia que o senhor também torcia para o Atlético; temos que ver algum jogo juntos.

small talk with a neighbour.text: Bueno, no le entretengo más, que seguro que tiene mil cosas que hacer.
small talk with a neighbour.en: Well, I won't keep you any longer, as I'm sure you've got a thousand things to do.
small talk with a neighbour.pt: Bom, não vou mais tomar seu tempo, que com certeza o senhor tem mil coisas para fazer.

phone calls and appointments.text: Buenos días, llamaba para pedir cita con la doctora Ruiz para la semana que viene.
phone calls and appointments.en: Good morning, I'm calling to make an appointment with Dr Ruiz for next week.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Bom dia, estou ligando para marcar uma consulta com a doutora Ruiz para a semana que vem.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Podría decirle a Javier que me devuelva la llamada en cuanto salga de la reunión?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you ask Javier to call me back as soon as he comes out of the meeting?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Poderia pedir ao Javier que me retorne a ligação assim que sair da reunião?

phone calls and appointments.text: Lo siento, se ha cortado la llamada porque creo que estaba entrando en un túnel.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, the call got cut off because I think I was going into a tunnel.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, a ligação caiu porque acho que eu estava entrando num túnel.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le llamo para confirmar su cita del jueves a las once con el fisioterapeuta.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm calling to confirm your appointment with the physiotherapist on Thursday at eleven.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou ligando para confirmar sua consulta de quinta às onze com o fisioterapeuta.

phone calls and appointments.text: Si no puede venir, le rogamos que nos avise con al menos veinticuatro horas de antelación.
phone calls and appointments.en: If you can't come, please let us know at least twenty-four hours in advance.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se não puder vir, pedimos que nos avise com pelo menos vinte e quatro horas de antecedência.

phone calls and appointments.text: Perdone, no le oigo bien; ¿podría repetir su número de teléfono más despacio?
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, I can't hear you very well; could you repeat your phone number more slowly?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, não estou ouvindo bem; poderia repetir seu número de telefone mais devagar?

phone calls and appointments.text: Llevo media hora esperando a que me atiendan y la musiquita ya me está volviendo loco.
phone calls and appointments.en: I've been on hold for half an hour and the hold music is driving me mad.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou há meia hora esperando para ser atendido e a musiquinha já está me deixando louco.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Le vendría bien cambiar la cita al viernes por la mañana en lugar del miércoles?
phone calls and appointments.en: Would it suit you to move the appointment to Friday morning instead of Wednesday?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Seria bom para o senhor mudar a consulta para sexta de manhã em vez de quarta?

phone calls and appointments.text: Ahora mismo no puedo hablar, pero te llamo en cuanto salga del metro.
phone calls and appointments.en: I can't talk right now, but I'll call you as soon as I get out of the metro.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Agora não posso falar, mas te ligo assim que sair do metrô.

phone calls and appointments.text: He intentado llamarte varias veces, pero siempre me salta el buzón de voz.
phone calls and appointments.en: I've tried calling you several times, but it always goes to voicemail.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Tentei te ligar várias vezes, mas sempre cai na caixa postal.

phone calls and appointments.text: La señora Gómez no está en este momento; ¿quiere dejarle algún recado?
phone calls and appointments.en: Mrs Gómez isn't here at the moment; would you like to leave her a message?
phone calls and appointments.pt: A senhora Gómez não está no momento; quer deixar algum recado?

phone calls and appointments.text: Necesitaría una cita para cortarme el pelo el sábado, a ser posible por la mañana.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd need an appointment for a haircut on Saturday, in the morning if possible.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Eu precisaria de um horário para cortar o cabelo no sábado, de preferência de manhã.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Me podría pasar con el departamento de reclamaciones, que es por un error en una factura?
phone calls and appointments.en: Could you put me through to the complaints department, as it's about a mistake on a bill?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Poderia me transferir para o setor de reclamações, que é sobre um erro numa fatura?

phone calls and appointments.text: Te mando un mensaje con la dirección para que no te pierdas cuando vengas.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll send you a message with the address so you don't get lost when you come.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Te mando uma mensagem com o endereço para você não se perder quando vier.

phone calls and appointments.text: Si me hubieras llamado antes, te habría hecho un hueco en la agenda esta misma tarde.
phone calls and appointments.en: If you'd called me earlier, I'd have fitted you into my diary this very afternoon.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se você tivesse me ligado antes, eu teria arrumado um horário na agenda hoje mesmo à tarde.

phone calls and appointments.text: Disculpe, me he equivocado de número; estaba buscando la clínica dental.
phone calls and appointments.en: Sorry, I've got the wrong number; I was looking for the dental clinic.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Desculpe, liguei para o número errado; estava procurando a clínica odontológica.

phone calls and appointments.text: Para pedir cita, marque el uno; para hablar con un operador, marque el cero.
phone calls and appointments.en: To make an appointment, press one; to speak to an operator, press zero.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Para marcar consulta, digite um; para falar com um atendente, digite zero.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿A qué hora te viene mejor que te llame para hablar con calma del viaje?
phone calls and appointments.en: What time suits you best for me to call so we can talk about the trip properly?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Que horas é melhor para você que eu te ligue para conversarmos com calma sobre a viagem?

phone calls and appointments.text: Me han dado cita para renovar el pasaporte dentro de tres semanas, que es lo primero que había.
phone calls and appointments.en: I've been given an appointment to renew my passport in three weeks, which was the earliest available.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Me deram horário para renovar o passaporte daqui a três semanas, que era o primeiro disponível.

phone calls and appointments.text: No te oigo nada porque hay muchísimo ruido, así que espera que salgo a la calle.
phone calls and appointments.en: I can't hear you at all because it's really noisy, so hang on while I step outside.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Não estou te ouvindo nada porque tem muito barulho, então espera que vou sair para a rua.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le llamamos de la compañía telefónica para ofrecerle una tarifa con más datos.
phone calls and appointments.en: We're calling from the phone company to offer you a plan with more data.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estamos ligando da operadora para oferecer ao senhor um plano com mais dados.

phone calls and appointments.text: Quería anular la cita que tenía mañana, porque me ha surgido un imprevisto en el trabajo.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'd like to cancel the appointment I had tomorrow, because something unexpected has come up at work.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Queria cancelar a consulta que eu tinha amanhã, porque surgiu um imprevisto no trabalho.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Sería tan amable de deletrearme su apellido para que lo apunte correctamente?
phone calls and appointments.en: Would you be so kind as to spell your surname for me so I can write it down correctly?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Poderia fazer a gentileza de soletrar seu sobrenome para eu anotar corretamente?

phone calls and appointments.text: Mi madre me llama todos los domingos por la noche, aunque no tenga nada que contarme.
phone calls and appointments.en: My mother calls me every Sunday night, even if she has nothing to tell me.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Minha mãe me liga todo domingo à noite, mesmo que não tenha nada para contar.

phone calls and appointments.text: Si quiere, puedo ponerle en lista de espera por si alguien cancela su cita.
phone calls and appointments.en: If you like, I can put you on the waiting list in case someone cancels their appointment.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Se quiser, posso colocar o senhor na lista de espera caso alguém cancele a consulta.

phone calls and appointments.text: Se me olvidó cargar el móvil y me quedé sin batería justo cuando iba a llamarte.
phone calls and appointments.en: I forgot to charge my phone and the battery died just as I was about to call you.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Esqueci de carregar o celular e fiquei sem bateria bem na hora em que ia te ligar.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Podemos hacer la reunión por videollamada en vez de en persona, que estoy en Málaga?
phone calls and appointments.en: Can we do the meeting by video call instead of in person, as I'm in Málaga?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Podemos fazer a reunião por videochamada em vez de presencialmente, que estou em Málaga?

phone calls and appointments.text: Tiene usted cita con el oculista el día tres de marzo a las cuatro menos cuarto.
phone calls and appointments.en: You have an appointment with the eye doctor on the third of March at a quarter to four.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O senhor tem consulta com o oftalmologista no dia três de março às quinze para as quatro.

phone calls and appointments.text: Llámame en cuanto llegues a casa, que así me quedo más tranquila.
phone calls and appointments.en: Call me as soon as you get home, so I don't worry.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Me liga assim que chegar em casa, que assim eu fico mais tranquila.

phone calls and appointments.text: Le paso con mi compañera, que es quien lleva su expediente.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'll put you through to my colleague, who's handling your file.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Vou transferir o senhor para minha colega, que é quem cuida do seu processo.

phone calls and appointments.text: No me gusta nada hablar por teléfono con desconocidos, así que prefiero pedir cita por internet.
phone calls and appointments.en: I really don't like talking on the phone to strangers, so I prefer booking appointments online.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Não gosto nada de falar ao telefone com desconhecidos, então prefiro marcar horário pela internet.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Le importa que le llame dentro de diez minutos, que ahora estoy conduciendo?
phone calls and appointments.en: Do you mind if I call you in ten minutes, as I'm driving right now?
phone calls and appointments.pt: O senhor se importa se eu ligar daqui a dez minutos, que agora estou dirigindo?

phone calls and appointments.text: El técnico dijo que vendría por la mañana, pero son las tres y no ha aparecido.
phone calls and appointments.en: The technician said he'd come in the morning, but it's three o'clock and he hasn't turned up.
phone calls and appointments.pt: O técnico disse que viria de manhã, mas já são três horas e ele não apareceu.

phone calls and appointments.text: Te llamo para recordarte que mañana tenemos la cena con los clientes a las nueve.
phone calls and appointments.en: I'm calling to remind you that tomorrow we have the dinner with the clients at nine.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estou ligando para te lembrar que amanhã temos o jantar com os clientes às nove.

phone calls and appointments.text: ¿Hay algún hueco libre esta semana o tendría que esperar hasta la próxima?
phone calls and appointments.en: Is there a free slot this week, or would I have to wait until next week?
phone calls and appointments.pt: Tem algum horário livre esta semana ou eu teria que esperar até a próxima?

phone calls and appointments.text: Ya he hablado con el seguro y me han dicho que mandarán a alguien a mirar el coche.
phone calls and appointments.en: I've spoken to the insurance company and they've told me they'll send someone to look at the car.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Já falei com o seguro e me disseram que vão mandar alguém para olhar o carro.

phone calls and appointments.text: Cuando llamé a la academia, me dijeron que las clases empezaban el uno de octubre.
phone calls and appointments.en: When I called the language school, they told me classes started on the first of October.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Quando liguei para a escola, me disseram que as aulas começavam no dia primeiro de outubro.

phone calls and appointments.text: Apúntame la cita en el calendario, que si no, seguro que se me olvida.
phone calls and appointments.en: Put the appointment in the calendar for me, because otherwise I'm bound to forget.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Anota a consulta no calendário para mim, que senão com certeza eu esqueço.

phone calls and appointments.text: Me extrañó que no me cogieras el teléfono, porque tú siempre contestas enseguida.
phone calls and appointments.en: I was surprised you didn't pick up, because you always answer straight away.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Estranhei você não atender o telefone, porque você sempre atende na hora.

phone calls and appointments.text: Gracias por llamar; en breve le atenderá uno de nuestros agentes.
phone calls and appointments.en: Thank you for calling; one of our agents will be with you shortly.
phone calls and appointments.pt: Obrigado por ligar; em breve um de nossos atendentes vai falar com você.
